context: Two teens recap a school sports day
purpose: Teach: につれて/につれ/おもしろかっ/めったに/浮かべ/挑む/如何に/太っ

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 今日の運動会、進むにつれてどんどん盛り上がったよね。
lines.en: Today's sports day just kept getting better as it went on.
lines.style: Bright, immediate energy. Quick opening. Warm observation, not performing for the crowd. Pace carries the momentum of the day itself.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 時間がたつにつれ、皆の声が枯れていくのが、めったにない経験だった。
lines.en: The way everyone's voices got hoarse as the hours went by—that was something I'd never really noticed before.
lines.style: Thoughtful, slightly marveling. Quiet wonder underneath. Speaks slowly enough to let the image settle. Noticing something the louder person might miss.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リレーの逆転、おもしろかった。表情に喜び浮かべて走ってたね。
lines.en: That relay turnaround was so good. The look on his face—pure joy, just running.
lines.style: Animated, genuine delight. Quick tempo on 'relay turnaround.' Slight soft pause before 'pure joy' like the image is still vivid. Real, not performed.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 冬休みに食べすぎて少し太ったけど、今日はちゃんと走れた。
lines.en: I put on weight over winter break, but today I actually ran like I meant it.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact, self-aware without shame. Light touch on the self-deprecation. Slight lift at the end—pride creeping in despite the joke.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 如何に練習が大事か、改めて感じたよ。
lines.en: It hit me again today how much practice actually matters.
lines.style: Quieter register. Genuine realization, not preaching. Slow, measured. The 'again' carries weight—she's learned this before and keeps forgetting.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.en: I'm going back out there next year.
lines.style: Quiet conviction. Simple, no extra flourish. The softness of it is more powerful than shouting. Settling into resolve.
